exceptions.source: Google multi-color logo SVG artwork.
exceptions.rationale: Third-party brand color must remain exact and should not be remapped to AMFM semantic tokens.
exceptions.alternatives: Use an external Google logo asset; semantic AMFM tokens were rejected because this is third-party brand artwork.
exceptions.promotionTrigger: Revisit only if Google brand artwork changes or this icon becomes an external asset.

exceptions.source: DPOsystem learn-more modal carousel viewport fit.
exceptions.rationale: The track height is a component-specific viewport clamp: it preserves a bounded desktop carousel while preventing the modal body from exceeding the viewport. A generic spacing token would be misleading because this is not a reusable spacing scale value.
exceptions.alternatives: A fixed scale height was rejected because it breaks shorter viewports; a broad token was rejected until a second carousel/modal needs the same clamp.
exceptions.blastRadius: DPOsystem Learn More dialog story track only.
exceptions.promotionTrigger: Promote to a named modal-carousel height token or utility if another carousel uses the same viewport clamp.

exceptions.source: GlobalNav account-card online indicator visual calibration.
exceptions.rationale: The online indicator uses a 1.5px punch-through border against the fixed dark nav surface. Rounding to Tailwind's 1px or 2px border width visibly changes the small indicator, and no second component currently shares this exact stroke width.
exceptions.alternatives: Use `border` or `border-2` if design accepts the visual change; promote a border-width token only if another component needs the same 1.5px stroke.
exceptions.promotionTrigger: Promote to a named border-width token if a second component needs the same 1.5px indicator stroke.

exceptions.source: DASHBOARD_FILTER_GROUPS Gender wrapClassName, pixel-verified against Figma node 4255:30881's "sidebar container".
exceptions.rationale: Each DashboardFilterMenu group wraps its chips into its own fixed-width column matching that group's confirmed Figma width; Gender's column is 62px. A generic spacing-scale token would round to a value that doesn't reproduce Figma's per-group wrap points.
exceptions.alternatives: A shared spacing-scale max-width was rejected because each of the 5 groups has a different, independently pixel-verified Figma column width — see COMPONENTS.md#dashboardfiltermenu Design tokens used.
exceptions.blastRadius: DashboardFilterMenu's Gender filter group column width only.
exceptions.promotionTrigger: Revisit only if Figma's confirmed column width for this group changes.
